g.text: louis-agent.pack.recipes: one search, step by step
the web search for that site
The hits, shuffled from several sites,
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: With no site named, a search asks four enabled sites at once and shuffles their hits;
with one, it asks that site. Each site searches its own way, and the list comes back
